text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and interested in helping you build clear Smartsheet dashboards that make project, bug, and helpdesk tracking easier to manage.

I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboard building, data cleaning, and data visualization, with a strong background in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. While my hands-on dashboard work has been in BI and reporting environments, the same core approach applies here: organizing messy data, structuring it so it is easy to maintain, and designing dashboards that give teams fast visibility into what matters.

A few relevant examples of my work:

- Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture: I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports. This consolidated reporting and cut monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours.
- HR attrition dashboard: I built an attrition and absence dashboard where each plant manager could only see their own plant. This dashboard covered 1,900 employees and helped identify attrition hotspots in 2 plants.

For your project, I can help design dashboards that are practical, clean, and easy to use for different audiences. That includes a portfolio dashboard for tracking projects, a bug dashboard for monitoring issue status, and a helpdesk dashboard for open items and follow-up. I focus on building reporting structures that make data easier to review, filter, and act on without unnecessary complexity.

I’m comfortable working with operational data, improving data quality, and turning raw information into dashboards that support day-to-day decision-making. If needed, I can also help think through layout, workflow, and reporting logic so the dashboards are useful for both management and team members.

If you’re looking for someone who can take a structured, detail-oriented approach and build reliable dashboard views, I’d be glad to help.
